The closing stages were physical, highlighted by several yellow cards, including one for Evren Eren Elmali deep in stoppage time. Despite Goztepe pushing forward in search of a late leveler, Galatasaray held firm through seven minutes of added time to secure a hard-fought three points in a classic league battle.
